image_description: A close-up, rear-view shot of a pelican floating on green water. The bird has white plumage on its head and neck, transitioning to dark grey/black feathers on its back and wings. Its distinctive long bill with a large orange gular pouch is visible in profile. The legs are partially submerged or obscured by the body angle.
